_readme: This file is the whole site. Edit it, run 'python build.py', refresh. Text fields support **bold**, *italic*, [link](https://…) and newlines.

site.description: Joyal Joy Madeckal and Anjana Raju invite you to their ring exchange, their wedding, and the reception in Trivandrum. Details and RSVP.

invitation.preamble: Join Us, As We Begin Our Forever...
invitation.lead: With hearts full of joy, We invite you to share these special moments with Us.
invitation.body: Three ceremonies, Across two districts and Two faiths - We’d love for you to be part of the whole celebration.

functions.name: Ring Exchange Ceremony
functions.tagline: A cozy evening ceremony with family and close friends, followed by a lively night of dancing, games, food, and joyful celebration.

functions.name: Wedding Ceremony
functions.tagline: A very intimate ceremony at Church, followed by lunch reception.

functions.name: Post Wedding Reception
functions.tagline: A celebration back at the Bride's home, for everyone in and around Trivandrum.

rsvp.title: Will you be joining us?
rsvp.intro: Please RSVP for each event separately — you’re welcome to be part of as many celebrations as you can make. We’d be grateful if you could let us know by **26th September 2026**, so we have enough time to make your visit as comfortable and special as possible. One RSVP per household is all you need.
rsvp.note: We'll email you a confirmation. Change of plans? Just reply to that email.

_gifts_readme: Two halves, each independent: 'url' drives the registry block, 'upi.id' drives the UPI block. Blank one and that half disappears; blank both and the whole section and its nav link go. Both QR codes are generated by build.py — you don't need a screenshot from PhonePe or Google Photos.

gifts.title: Gifts
gifts.intro: Honestly, your presence, love and blessings are all we could ask for — gifts are absolutely not expected!
gifts.body: But if you're the kind who insists on bringing something anyway, we've put together a little registry, just to make sure whatever you choose is something we'll truly love, use and cherish.
gifts.description: And if the registry didn’t quite do it for you, here’s a little something towards kickstarting our life together
gifts.copyHint: If the QR won't scan, tap this and paste the UPI ID into your app.
